name: Customer Tier and Credit Filter
sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS gold_customers FROM customers WHERE tier = 'GOLD' AND credit_limit >= 1000 GROUP BY country HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000;
description: Groups GOLD customers by country and filters for countries with at least 1000 qualified customers.

name: Shipped High-Value Orders
sql: SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS shipped_orders, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_val FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'SHIPPED' AND o.total_amount > 100 GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) >= 1000;
description: Joins customers and orders to find customers with at least 1000 shipped high-value orders.

name: Delivered Orders of Platinum Customers
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS delivered_count, AVG(o.total_amount) AS avg_amount FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.tier = 'PLATINUM' AND o.order_status = 'DELIVERED' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) >= 1500 AND AVG(o.total_amount) > 50;
description: Aggregates delivered orders of Platinum customers, requiring at least 1500 orders with average amount above 50.

name: Electronics Products in Price Range
sql: SELECT cat.category_name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count, AVG(p.price) AS avg_price FROM products p JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id WHERE cat.department = 'ELECTRONICS' AND p.price BETWEEN 50 AND 500 GROUP BY cat.category_id, cat.category_name HAVING COUNT(p.product_id) >= 1000;
description: Finds electronics categories containing at least 1000 products within the price range.

name: Long Duration Purchase Events
sql: SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS event_count, AVG(duration_seconds) AS avg_duration FROM customer_events WHERE duration_seconds >= 60 GROUP BY event_type HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2000;
description: Aggregates event types with duration of at least 60 seconds, requiring at least 2000 events.

name: Offset Paged High Temperature Sensor Readings
sql: SELECT telemetry_id, device_id, metric_value, reading_seq FROM sensor_telemetry WHERE metric_name = 'TEMP' AND metric_value > 25.0 ORDER BY reading_seq LIMIT 10 OFFSET 1000;
description: Paginates sensor temperature readings with LIMIT 10 OFFSET 1000, requiring at least 1001 readings.

name: Fast FedEx Shipments
sql: SELECT s.carrier, COUNT(o.order_id) AS shipment_count, AVG(s.delivery_days) AS avg_days FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id WHERE s.carrier = 'FEDEX' AND s.delivery_days <= 3 GROUP BY s.carrier HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) >= 1000;
description: Finds FedEx carriers with at least 1000 fast shipments of at most 3 delivery days.

name: Discounted Multi-Item Order Lines
sql: SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS distinct_products, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE oi.quantity >= 2 AND oi.discount > 0.05 GROUP BY o.order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) >= 1000;
description: Identifies orders with at least 1000 distinct discounted products in bulk quantities.

name: Offset Paged Inventory Restock Logs
sql: SELECT log_id, product_id, change_amount, log_seq FROM inventory_logs WHERE change_type = 'RESTOCK' AND change_amount >= 10 ORDER BY log_seq LIMIT 10 OFFSET 2000;
description: Paginates inventory restock logs using LIMIT 10 OFFSET 2000, requiring at least 2001 rows.

name: Mid-Tier Customer Credit Evaluation
sql: SELECT country, tier, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, AVG(credit_limit) AS avg_limit FROM customers WHERE country = 'US' AND credit_limit BETWEEN 500 AND 5000 AND tier IN ('SILVER', 'GOLD') GROUP BY country, tier HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1200;
description: Groups mid-tier US customers, requiring at least 1200 customers per tier group.

name: Frequent High-Spending Customers
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) >= 5000 AND SUM(o.total_amount) > 50000;
description: Groups orders by customer and filters for those with at least 5000 orders and total spend over 50000.

name: Customers Buying Multiple Distinct Products
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS distinct_products FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) >= 5000;
description: Aggregates items purchased across orders to find customers buying at least 5000 distinct products.

name: Department Revenue Summary
sql: SELECT cat.department, COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) AS product_count, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue FROM categories cat JOIN products p ON p.category_id = cat.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY cat.department HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) >= 5000 AND SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) > 50000;
description: Calculates revenue per department and filters for departments with at least 5000 products and generating over 50000.

name: Carrier Delivery Efficiency
sql: SELECT s.carrier, COUNT(o.order_id) AS shipment_count, AVG(s.delivery_days) AS avg_delivery_days FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'DELIVERED' GROUP BY s.carrier HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) >= 8000 AND AVG(s.delivery_days) < 10.0;
description: Evaluates carrier average delivery days on delivered orders with at least 8000 shipments.

name: Engaged Customer Activity Profiles
sql: SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(ce.event_id) AS total_events, AVG(ce.duration_seconds) AS avg_duration FROM customers c JOIN customer_events ce ON ce.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE ce.duration_seconds >= 30 GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name HAVING COUNT(ce.event_id) >= 10000;
description: Finds customers with at least 10000 events of duration 30 seconds or more.

name: Offset Paged Shipped Customer Orders
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, o.order_id, o.order_date, o.total_amount FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'SHIPPED' ORDER BY o.order_date, o.order_id LIMIT 10 OFFSET 10000;
description: Retrieves shipped customer orders skipped by OFFSET 10000, requiring at least 10001 shipped orders.

name: Offset Paged Discounted Order Items
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, oi.item_id, oi.quantity, oi.discount FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.discount > 0.05 ORDER BY oi.item_id LIMIT 10 OFFSET 12000;
description: Retrieves discounted order items past OFFSET 12000, requiring at least 12001 qualifying rows.

name: Device Voltage Monitoring Aggregation
sql: SELECT device_id, COUNT(*) AS sample_count, AVG(metric_value) AS avg_voltage, MAX(metric_value) AS peak_voltage FROM sensor_telemetry WHERE metric_name = 'VOLTAGE' GROUP BY device_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 15000 AND AVG(metric_value) > 10.0;
description: Aggregates telemetry voltage samples per device, requiring at least 15000 samples and average voltage above 10.0.

name: Paid Orders with Discounted Items
sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, COUNT(oi.item_id) AS line_items, MAX(oi.discount) AS max_discount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_status = 'PAID' GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id HAVING COUNT(oi.item_id) >= 10000 AND MAX(oi.discount) >= 0.1;
description: Finds paid orders with multiple line items where at least 10000 items are present and at least one received a discount of 10% or more.

name: Regional Customer Credit Distribution
sql: SELECT country, tier, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, AVG(credit_limit) AS avg_credit FROM customers GROUP BY country, tier HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20000 AND AVG(credit_limit) >= 1000;
description: Groups customers by country and tier, filtering cells with at least 20000 customers and average credit of at least 1000.

name: Window Ranked Order Thresholds
sql: WITH ranked_orders AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.order_date, o.total_amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_id ASC) AS rn FROM orders o) SELECT r.order_id, c.customer_name, r.order_date, r.total_amount FROM ranked_orders r JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id WHERE r.rn >= 50000 AND r.total_amount > 100;
description: Window ROW_NUMBER requiring a customer to accumulate at least 50000 orders before returning.

name: Deep Offset Paged Customer Event Streams
sql: SELECT ce.event_id, c.customer_name, ce.event_type, ce.duration_seconds, ce.event_seq FROM customer_events ce JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = ce.customer_id WHERE ce.duration_seconds >= 10 ORDER BY ce.event_seq LIMIT 10 OFFSET 100000;
description: Paginates customer events with OFFSET 100000 (1 lakh), strictly requiring at least 100001 rows in the dataset.

name: Window Dense Rank Depth on Sensor Telemetry
sql: WITH ranked_metrics AS (SELECT device_id, metric_name, metric_value, reading_seq, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY metric_value ASC) AS rnk FROM sensor_telemetry WHERE metric_name = 'TEMP') SELECT device_id, metric_name, metric_value, reading_seq FROM ranked_metrics WHERE rnk >= 50000;
description: Applies DENSE_RANK over temperature readings, requiring at least 50000 distinct metric values for a device.

name: Deep Offset Paged Multi-Table Order Deliveries
sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_name, s.carrier, s.delivery_days FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE s.tracking_status = 'DELIVERED' ORDER BY o.order_id LIMIT 10 OFFSET 75000;
description: Three-table join paginated past OFFSET 75000, requiring at least 75001 delivered orders.

name: High Cardinality Step Accumulator on Inventory Logs
sql: WITH running_stock AS (SELECT il.product_id, il.log_seq, il.change_amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY il.product_id ORDER BY il.log_seq ASC) AS seq_num FROM inventory_logs il WHERE il.change_type = 'RESTOCK') SELECT rs.product_id, p.product_name, rs.log_seq, rs.seq_num FROM running_stock rs JOIN products p ON p.product_id = rs.product_id WHERE rs.seq_num >= 100000;
description: Restock sequence tracker requiring at least 100000 (1 lakh) restock log entries for a single product.

name: Subquery Cardinality Barrier on Customer Orders
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name FROM customers c WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id) >= 100000;
description: Correlated subquery barrier requiring at least 100000 (1 lakh) orders for a single customer.

name: Offset Paged Telemetry Reading Windows
sql: SELECT telemetry_id, device_id, metric_name, metric_value, reading_seq FROM sensor_telemetry WHERE metric_name = 'PRESSURE' ORDER BY reading_seq LIMIT 10 OFFSET 150000;
description: Paginates telemetry pressure readings with OFFSET 150000 (1.5 lakhs), requiring at least 150001 readings.

name: Multi-Carrier Large Volume Delivery Performance
sql: WITH delivered_shipments AS (SELECT o.order_id, s.carrier, s.delivery_days FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'DELIVERED' AND s.tracking_status = 'DELIVERED' AND s.delivery_days <= 10), carrier_sla AS (SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS completed_deliveries, AVG(delivery_days) AS mean_days FROM delivered_shipments GROUP BY carrier) SELECT carrier, completed_deliveries, mean_days FROM carrier_sla WHERE completed_deliveries >= 50000;
description: Carrier delivery performance CTE requiring at least 50000 delivered orders for a carrier.

name: High-Volume Customer Order Aggregation
sql: WITH customer_spending AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.country, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_cnt, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'PAID' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.country HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) >= 100000 AND SUM(o.total_amount) >= 1000000) SELECT cs.customer_id, cs.customer_name, cs.total_spent FROM customer_spending cs;
description: Requires at least 100000 (1 lakh) paid orders for a single customer to satisfy the aggregate condition.

name: Deep Paged Order Items Across Catalog
sql: SELECT oi.item_id, o.order_id, p.product_name, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id ORDER BY oi.item_id LIMIT 10 OFFSET 100000;
description: Paginates catalog order items past OFFSET 100000 (1 lakh), requiring at least 100001 rows across 3 tables.

name: Bounded Credit Limit Sum and Max with Unique Customers
sql: SELECT country, SUM(credit_limit) AS total_credit, MAX(credit_limit) AS max_credit FROM customers WHERE tier = 'GOLD' GROUP BY country HAVING SUM(credit_limit) > 100000 AND MAX(credit_limit) <= 100;
description: Requires SUM(credit_limit) > 100000 while MAX(credit_limit) <= 100 per country, forcing at least 1001 GOLD customer rows with UNIQUE customer_name.

name: Shipped Orders Bounded Sum and Max
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_val, MAX(o.total_amount) AS max_order_val FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'SHIPPED' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name HAVING SUM(o.total_amount) > 50000 AND MAX(o.total_amount) <= 50;
description: Joins customers and orders with SUM(total_amount) > 50000 and MAX(total_amount) <= 50, requiring at least 1001 shipped orders for a customer.

name: Bounded Duration Purchase Events with Composite Unique Sequence
sql: SELECT customer_id, event_type, SUM(duration_seconds) AS total_duration, MAX(duration_seconds) AS max_duration FROM customer_events WHERE event_type = 'PURCHASE' AND duration_seconds <= 10 GROUP BY customer_id, event_type HAVING SUM(duration_seconds) >= 15000;
description: Caps each event at duration_seconds <= 10 while requiring SUM(duration_seconds) >= 15000, forcing at least 1500 rows satisfying UNIQUE(customer_id, event_seq).

name: Schema Check Bounded Discount Sum with Unique Order-Product Cascade
sql: SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.discount) AS total_discount, MAX(oi.discount) AS max_discount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE oi.quantity >= 1 GROUP BY o.order_id HAVING SUM(oi.discount) >= 1000;
description: Relies on schema CHECK (discount <= 1.0) and HAVING SUM(discount) >= 1000 to require 1000 order_items for one order; UNIQUE(order_id, product_id) cascades to require 1000 distinct products.

name: Scale-Free Price Sum-to-Max Ratio with Unique Product Names
sql: SELECT cat.category_name, SUM(p.price) AS total_catalog_price, MAX(p.price) AS max_product_price FROM categories cat JOIN products p ON p.category_id = cat.category_id WHERE cat.department = 'ELECTRONICS' GROUP BY cat.category_id, cat.category_name HAVING SUM(p.price) >= 1200 * MAX(p.price);
description: Enforces SUM(price) >= 1200 * MAX(price) with price > 0, mathematically requiring at least 1200 products with UNIQUE product_name regardless of price scale.

name: Telemetry Average Skew Lever with Min and Max Bounds
sql: SELECT device_id, MIN(metric_value) AS min_val, MAX(metric_value) AS max_val, AVG(metric_value) AS avg_val FROM sensor_telemetry WHERE metric_name = 'TEMP' AND metric_value BETWEEN 10.0 AND 100.0 GROUP BY device_id HAVING MIN(metric_value) <= 10.0 AND AVG(metric_value) >= 99.91;
description: Combines MIN(metric_value) <= 10.0, upper bound 100.0, and AVG(metric_value) >= 99.91, requiring at least 1000 readings with UNIQUE(device_id, metric_name, reading_seq).

name: Unique Order Shipment Fan-Out with Bounded Delivery Days Sum
sql: SELECT s.carrier, SUM(s.delivery_days) AS total_days, MAX(s.delivery_days) AS max_days FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id WHERE s.carrier = 'FEDEX' AND s.delivery_days <= 3 GROUP BY s.carrier HAVING SUM(s.delivery_days) >= 3000 AND MAX(s.delivery_days) <= 3;
description: Requires SUM(delivery_days) >= 3000 with MAX(delivery_days) <= 3 (at least 1000 shipments); shipments.order_id UNIQUE forces 1000 distinct parent orders.

name: High-Volume Customer Spend Bounded Sum and Max
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent, MAX(o.total_amount) AS max_order FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'PAID' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name HAVING SUM(o.total_amount) > 500000 AND MAX(o.total_amount) <= 100;
description: Requires SUM(total_amount) > 500000 and MAX(total_amount) <= 100 per customer, forcing at least 5001 paid orders.

name: Multi-Table Bounded Quantity Sum with Composite Unique Items
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units, MAX(oi.quantity) AS max_line_units, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS unique_products FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name HAVING SUM(oi.quantity) >= 25000 AND MAX(oi.quantity) <= 5;
description: Requires SUM(quantity) >= 25000 with MAX(quantity) <= 5 across a 3-table join, forcing at least 5000 order_items satisfying UNIQUE(order_id, product_id).

name: Bounded Line-Item Revenue Product Sum
sql: SELECT cat.department, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_revenue, MAX(oi.unit_price) AS max_unit_price FROM categories cat JOIN products p ON p.category_id = cat.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.quantity <= 2 AND oi.unit_price <= 50.0 GROUP BY cat.department HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) >= 500000;
description: Bounds each line item's revenue contribution to at most 2 * 50 = 100 while requiring SUM(quantity * unit_price) >= 500000, forcing at least 5000 order_items.

name: Carrier Delivery Days Sum-Minus-Max Gap with Unique Order Shipments
sql: SELECT s.carrier, SUM(s.delivery_days) AS total_days, MAX(s.delivery_days) AS max_days FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'DELIVERED' GROUP BY s.carrier HAVING SUM(s.delivery_days) - MAX(s.delivery_days) >= 40000 AND MAX(s.delivery_days) <= 5;
description: Requires SUM(delivery_days) - MAX(delivery_days) >= 40000 with MAX(delivery_days) <= 5, forcing at least 8001 shipments and 8001 distinct orders via UNIQUE(order_id).

name: Engaged Customer Event Duration Bounded Sum and Max
sql: SELECT c.customer_name, SUM(ce.duration_seconds) AS total_duration, MAX(ce.duration_seconds) AS max_duration, COUNT(DISTINCT ce.event_seq) AS distinct_seqs FROM customers c JOIN customer_events ce ON ce.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name HAVING SUM(ce.duration_seconds) >= 80000 AND MAX(ce.duration_seconds) <= 10;
description: Requires SUM(duration_seconds) >= 80000 with MAX(duration_seconds) <= 10, forcing at least 8000 customer_events with distinct event_seq values.

name: Customer Order Outlier Max and Low Average Lever
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, MIN(o.total_amount) AS min_amt, MAX(o.total_amount) AS max_amt, AVG(o.total_amount) AS avg_amt FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.total_amount >= 10.0 GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name HAVING MAX(o.total_amount) >= 50000.0 AND AVG(o.total_amount) <= 15.0;
description: Forces one order >= 50000 while all orders are >= 10 and AVG <= 15, requiring at least 9998 orders to dilute the outlier down to an average of 15.

name: Restock Quantity Sum-to-Max Ratio with Composite Unique Sequence
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(il.change_amount) AS total_restocked, MAX(il.change_amount) AS max_single_restock FROM products p JOIN inventory_logs il ON il.product_id = p.product_id WHERE il.change_type = 'RESTOCK' AND il.change_amount > 0 GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name HAVING SUM(il.change_amount) >= 6000 * MAX(il.change_amount);
description: Requires SUM(change_amount) >= 6000 * MAX(change_amount) for positive restocks, forcing at least 6000 inventory_logs rows with distinct log_seq.

name: Device Voltage Telemetry Bounded Sum and Peak
sql: SELECT device_id, SUM(metric_value) AS total_voltage, MAX(metric_value) AS peak_voltage, MIN(metric_value) AS min_voltage FROM sensor_telemetry WHERE metric_name = 'VOLTAGE' GROUP BY device_id HAVING SUM(metric_value) >= 120000 AND MAX(metric_value) <= 12.0;
description: Aggregates telemetry voltage per device with SUM >= 120000 and MAX <= 12.0, requiring at least 10000 readings with UNIQUE(device_id, metric_name, reading_seq).

name: Paid Order Discount Sum with Unique Product Fan-Out
sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, SUM(oi.discount) AS sum_discount, MAX(oi.discount) AS max_discount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_status = 'PAID' GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id HAVING SUM(oi.discount) >= 7500 AND MAX(oi.discount) <= 0.75;
description: Requires SUM(discount) >= 7500 and MAX(discount) <= 0.75 for a paid order, forcing 10000 order_items and 10000 distinct products due to UNIQUE(order_id, product_id).

name: Window Cumulative Spend Threshold with Bounded Order Amounts
sql: WITH running_orders AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.total_amount, SUM(o.total_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_id ASC) AS running_spend FROM orders o WHERE o.total_amount <= 10.0) SELECT r.order_id, c.customer_name, r.total_amount, r.running_spend FROM running_orders r JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id WHERE r.running_spend >= 500000.0;
description: Computes running SUM(total_amount) over orders capped at total_amount <= 10.0 and filters for running_spend >= 500000.0, requiring at least 50000 orders.

name: Deep Window LAG Offset on Customer Event Streams
sql: WITH lagged_stream AS (SELECT ce.event_id, ce.customer_id, ce.event_seq, ce.duration_seconds, LAG(ce.event_seq, 25000) OVER (PARTITION BY ce.customer_id ORDER BY ce.event_seq ASC) AS lag_seq FROM customer_events ce WHERE ce.duration_seconds <= 60) SELECT ls.event_id, c.customer_name, ls.event_seq, ls.lag_seq FROM lagged_stream ls JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = ls.customer_id WHERE ls.lag_seq IS NOT NULL;
description: Uses LAG(event_seq, 25000) and filters for lag_seq IS NOT NULL, strictly requiring at least 25001 events for a single customer with UNIQUE(customer_id, event_seq).

name: Two-Stage Hierarchical CTE Bounded Sum Multiplication
sql: WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.country, SUM(o.total_amount) AS cust_spend, MAX(o.total_amount) AS max_order FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'DELIVERED' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.country HAVING SUM(o.total_amount) >= 2000 AND MAX(o.total_amount) <= 20) SELECT country, COUNT(customer_id) AS qualified_customers, SUM(cust_spend) AS country_spend FROM customer_totals GROUP BY country HAVING SUM(cust_spend) >= 500000 AND MAX(cust_spend) <= 2000;
description: Inner CTE requires >= 100 orders per customer (SUM >= 2000, MAX <= 20); outer query requires >= 250 such customers per country (SUM >= 500000, MAX <= 2000), totaling 25000 orders and 250 unique-name customers.

name: Window Cumulative Restock Quantity with Bounded Step
sql: WITH running_stock AS (SELECT il.product_id, il.log_seq, il.change_amount, SUM(il.change_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY il.product_id ORDER BY il.log_seq ASC) AS running_qty FROM inventory_logs il WHERE il.change_type = 'RESTOCK' AND il.change_amount <= 5) SELECT rs.product_id, p.product_name, rs.log_seq, rs.running_qty FROM running_stock rs JOIN products p ON p.product_id = rs.product_id WHERE rs.running_qty >= 250000;
description: Accumulates restock change_amount capped at 5 per row until running_qty >= 250000, requiring at least 50000 inventory_logs rows with UNIQUE(product_id, log_seq).

name: Correlated Subquery Bounded Sum and Max Barrier
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name FROM customers c WHERE (SELECT SUM(o.total_amount) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id) > 400000 AND (SELECT MAX(o.total_amount) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id) <= 10;
description: Correlated subqueries require a customer's total order sum to exceed 400000 while max order amount is <= 10, forcing at least 40001 orders.

name: CTE Carrier Delivery Days Sum-to-Max Ratio with Unique Shipment FK
sql: WITH carrier_metrics AS (SELECT s.carrier, SUM(s.delivery_days) AS total_days, MAX(s.delivery_days) AS max_days FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'DELIVERED' AND s.tracking_status = 'DELIVERED' AND s.delivery_days > 0 GROUP BY s.carrier) SELECT carrier, total_days, max_days FROM carrier_metrics WHERE total_days >= 50000 * max_days;
description: Requires total_days >= 50000 * max_days for positive delivery_days, forcing 50000 shipments and 50000 distinct orders due to shipments.order_id UNIQUE.

name: Extreme Pressure Telemetry Average Skew Lever in CTE
sql: WITH device_stats AS (SELECT device_id, MIN(metric_value) AS min_v, MAX(metric_value) AS max_v, AVG(metric_value) AS avg_v, SUM(metric_value) AS sum_v FROM sensor_telemetry WHERE metric_name = 'PRESSURE' AND metric_value BETWEEN 1.0 AND 100.0 GROUP BY device_id) SELECT device_id, min_v, max_v, avg_v, sum_v FROM device_stats WHERE min_v <= 1.0 AND max_v <= 100.0 AND avg_v >= 99.998;
description: Requires MIN <= 1.0, MAX <= 100.0, and AVG >= 99.998 on pressure readings, forcing at least 49500 rows with UNIQUE(device_id, metric_name, reading_seq).

name: CTE Bulk Order Bounded Quantity Sum with Unique Catalog Fan-Out
sql: WITH bulk_orders AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty, MAX(oi.quantity) AS max_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_name) AS distinct_prod_names FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_status = 'PAID' GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id HAVING SUM(oi.quantity) >= 100000 AND MAX(oi.quantity) <= 2) SELECT order_id, customer_id, total_qty, distinct_prod_names FROM bulk_orders;
description: Requires SUM(quantity) >= 100000 and MAX(quantity) <= 2 per order (50000 order_items); UNIQUE(order_id, product_id) forces 50000 distinct products with UNIQUE product_name.
